title: Career Roadmap · Salon Technician
summary: A Salon Technician provides hands-on hair, beauty, nail or salon-support services, depending on specialization, while maintaining hygiene, equipment safety and client-service standards.

about.label: Common pathway
about.text: Class 10 / 12 → Recognized salon / beauty vocational training → Supervised practical experience → Salon Technician → Senior Technician / Specialist / Salon Supervisor.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Any stream may be suitable for vocational training; confirm provider requirements.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: Biology, basic chemistry, communication and business studies.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Hair care, skincare, styling, nail services, hygiene and customer service.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Manual dexterity, attention to detail, sanitation, teamwork and time management.

blocks.label: Entry route
blocks.text: Certificate, diploma or apprenticeship-style training with practical sessions.

items.text: Beauty & Wellness vocational qualification → General salon-service skills.
Hairdresser / Hair Stylist training → Hair washing, cutting, styling and related services, according to qualification scope.
Beauty Therapist training → Skincare and selected beauty treatments.
Nail Technology training → Manicure, pedicure and nail services.
Salon Operations / Assistant training → Client reception, equipment preparation, hygiene and inventory support.

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: “Salon Technician” can mean different roles between employers. Choose a course based on the actual tasks required and verify its practical content and recognition.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Salon hygiene, tool handling, client service and workplace safety.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Technical skills
blocks.text: Hair washing and styling, basic beauty services or nail care, depending on the chosen role.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Supervised practice
blocks.text: Client preparation, service delivery, sanitation and feedback.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career readiness
blocks.text: Portfolio, appointment handling, product knowledge and teamwork.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Salon hygiene checklist; client-service record; hair-styling portfolio; tool cleaning and maintenance schedule.

blocks.label: Skill ecosystem
blocks.text: B&WSSC-aligned training providers and approved practical-learning centres.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: Salons, spas, beauty studios, hotels and grooming chains.

blocks.label: Ideal experience areas
blocks.text: Hair services, salon preparation, beauty treatments, nail care and customer service.
Select placements that provide supervision and clear hygiene protocols. Internships and jobs are not guaranteed.

blocks.label: Business route
blocks.text: Practical experience + customer-service and business skills → salon supervisor or owner.

The official B&WSSC qualification list includes distinct roles such as Junior Hair Dresser & Stylist, Beauty Therapist and Pedicurist and Manicurist. Select the qualification that matches the intended work.
